title: Solomon and Hiram Make Peace
reflectionText: Rest opened a way for Solomon to begin the work David could not complete. Hiram answered his request with skilled labor, timber, and a covenant of peace, while Solomon supplied food in return. What do you notice about wisdom taking shape through clear requests, shared work, and faithful provision?
editorialNotes: Packet 020 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling stays within 1 Kings 5:1-12 and preserves the reciprocal terms of Solomon and Hiram without importing later temple construction.
